purpose: exploratory detector-attribution comparison requested after the canonical e-ATS evaluation

triggers: fast xlogx GLR identity returned -1.1641532182693481e-10 for a near-zero exact statistic
independent blockwise likelihood subtraction returned -1.8189894035458565e-12 for a near-zero exact statistic
post_start_numerical_amendment.change: when the fast table identity is negative, recompute that component from independent blockwise Bernoulli maximized log likelihoods; accept zero only when the recomputed negative value lies within 64 times binary64 epsilon times the arm-local observation count
post_start_numerical_amendment.guard_behavior: fail when the independently recomputed negative statistic exceeds the explicit observation-count-scaled forward-error allowance

selection.full_table_rows: all four B values for K=4 and K=32
selection.selection_timing: chosen after canonical e-ATS outcomes were known
selection.selection_rationale: include the reported K=4 reversal and a larger-action-space row rather than selecting only a favorable e-ATS regime

calibration.population: registered stationary random environments for the selected geometries
calibration.detector_trace: strict OTS action and reward trajectory
calibration.glr_statistic: maximum over time, arms, and the canonical geometric candidate grid of the two-segment Bernoulli log generalized likelihood ratio against one pooled Bernoulli mean
calibration.threshold_rule: within each K_B geometry choose an interior cutoff giving exactly the canonical e-process stationary crossing count; when that count is zero use nextafter(maximum_calibration_score,+infinity)
calibration.e_crossing_source: archived canonical restart-e-process F_E on the same trajectory; first-crossing identity follows from the shared OTS prefix
calibration.interpretation: empirical matched crossing frequency on a repeated-tape stationary calibration population

policies.strict_ots: archived strict OTS outcome from the canonical evaluation
policies.always_open_ramp: archived canonical no-C^E full-budget normalized-ramp outcome
policies.glr_e_ats: new run replacing only the historical authorization latch with the calibrated GLR latch

fairness_constraints: GLR threshold calibration uses stationary outcomes only
GLR and e-process use the same geometric candidate splits
GLR changes only the authorization event; ramp, latch persistence, short discount, reliability, score, tie rule, and controller constants remain fixed
all comparisons are paired on identical means, potential rewards, and initial RNG descriptors
no policy receives access to the nonstationary evaluation outcomes during tuning

inference.estimand: mean normalized dynamic pseudo-regret in the selected random nonstationary environment-tape groups
